name: android_scroll
description: Performs a directional scroll or inertial fling gesture (up, down, left, right) on scrollable views (RecyclerView, ScrollView, LazyColumn).

direction.description: Scroll direction (down reveals lower content, up reveals higher content). Default: down.

distance.description: Fractional screen distance to scroll (0.1..1.0, default 0.6).

speed.description: Scroll speed/inertia: fast (high-inertia fling), normal (smooth scroll), slow (drag). Default: normal.

startX.description: Coordinate. Raw pairs where both values are within 0.0-1.0 are interpreted as normalized screen ratios; otherwise as physical pixels. Use the *Ratio or *Pixel variants to pin the unit explicitly.

startY.description: Coordinate. Raw pairs where both values are within 0.0-1.0 are interpreted as normalized screen ratios; otherwise as physical pixels. Use the *Ratio or *Pixel variants to pin the unit explicitly.

endX.description: Coordinate. Raw pairs where both values are within 0.0-1.0 are interpreted as normalized screen ratios; otherwise as physical pixels. Use the *Ratio or *Pixel variants to pin the unit explicitly.

endY.description: Coordinate. Raw pairs where both values are within 0.0-1.0 are interpreted as normalized screen ratios; otherwise as physical pixels. Use the *Ratio or *Pixel variants to pin the unit explicitly.

startXRatio.description: Explicit normalized coordinate ratio from 0.0 to 1.0 (screen-relative). Takes precedence over raw x/y.

startYRatio.description: Explicit normalized coordinate ratio from 0.0 to 1.0 (screen-relative). Takes precedence over raw x/y.

endXRatio.description: Explicit normalized coordinate ratio from 0.0 to 1.0 (screen-relative). Takes precedence over raw x/y.

endYRatio.description: Explicit normalized coordinate ratio from 0.0 to 1.0 (screen-relative). Takes precedence over raw x/y.

startXPixel.description: Explicit physical screen pixel coordinate (integer or float). Takes precedence over raw x/y.

startYPixel.description: Explicit physical screen pixel coordinate (integer or float). Takes precedence over raw x/y.

endXPixel.description: Explicit physical screen pixel coordinate (integer or float). Takes precedence over raw x/y.

endYPixel.description: Explicit physical screen pixel coordinate (integer or float). Takes precedence over raw x/y.
